name: Ellipsoid SDDF Prior
aliases: Ellipsoid SDDF Prior — Ellipsoid Signed Directional Distance Function, Single Ellipsoid SDDF
Single ellipsoid E defined by center c, rotation R, and radii r
definition: A closed-form analytical function f(p, v; E) that computes the Signed Directional Distance Function (SDDF) for a single ellipsoid E, providing a geometric prior for neural rendering.
summary: The Ellipsoid SDDF Prior is an explicit geometric representation using learnable ellipsoids to approximate coarse shapes, providing an analytic, differentiable prior that handles occlusions explicitly.
